obs: “The canon requiring a court to give effect to each word if possible is sometimes offset by the canon that permits a court to reject words as surplus-age if inadvertently inserted or if repugnant to the rest of the statute . . . .”

"See Chickasaw Nation v. United States, 534 U. S. 84, 94 (2001) (the preference is sometimes offset by the canon that permits a court to reject words as surplusage if inadvertently inserted or if repugnant to the rest of the statute)."
